title: Whose record is this? Diagnosing and authorizing record use in personalized multimodal models
abstract: arXiv:2609.04801v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Contextualized visual personalization can retrieve a true record yet apply it to the wrong visual subject. We formalize when a record may condition an answer as \emph{record authorization}: subject presence ($P$), record-edge validity ($E$), and answer support ($S$) must all hold. We call violations visual memory misbinding (VMM). We construct RecordAuth-Diag, a 3,690-case matched diagnostic suite that changes one image--record edge while holding the query, question, record text, and image multiset fixed. Card removal and nonce relabeling attribute these failures to supplied records. Raw-bank failures span Qwen-, Phi-, and Gemma-family interfaces: Gemma-3-4B-IT reaches 63.69\% local unauthorized use at 25.75\% clean recall. CoViP remains at 26.02\%, versus 22.49\% for its Qwen backbone at similar clean recall. translated_title: 这是谁的记录？个性化多模态模型中记录使用的诊断与授权
translated_abstract: 情境化的视觉个性化可能检索到真实的记录，却将其应用于错误的视觉主体。我们形式化了记录何时可以用于约束答案，称之为“记录授权”：主体存在性（P）、记录-边缘有效性（E）以及答案支持性（S）必须全部成立。我们将违反这些条件的情况称为视觉记忆错误绑定（VMM）。我们构建了RecordAuth-Diag，这是一个包含3,690个案例的匹配诊断套件，它在保持查询、问题、记录文本和图像多重集合不变的情况下，仅改变一条图像-记录边缘。卡片移除和随机标签重命名实验将这些失败归因于所提供的记录。原始记录库的失败跨越了Qwen、Phi和Gemma系列模型接口：Gemma-3-4B-IT在25.75%的干净召回率下达到了63.69%的局部未授权使用率。CoViP保持在26.02%，而其Qwen骨干网络在相近的干净召回率下为22.49%。类型化的预生成授权将Qwen在RecordAuth-Diag上的卡片暴露率从43.63%降低到3.06%，同时正向召回率……（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文形式化了个性化多模态模型中的“记录授权”问题，识别出视觉记忆错误绑定（VMM）这一新失效模式，构建了包含3,690个案例的RecordAuth-Diag诊断套件，揭示了Qwen、Phi、Gemma等主流模型家族中普遍存在的未授权记录使用问题，并提出类型化预生成授权方法将卡片暴露率从43.63%大幅降至3.06%。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes "record authorization" in personalized multimodal models, identifies a novel failure mode called visual memory misbinding (VMM), introduces RecordAuth-Diag—a 3,690-case diagnostic suite revealing widespread unauthorized record use across Qwen, Phi, and Gemma model families—and proposes typed pre-generation authorization that reduces card exposure from 43.63% to 3.06%.
